1. (Currently amended) A golf tee comprising a long lasting combination of a golf tee and a force absorbing member in association therewith, said tee including a ground insertion end, a ball support end and a shaft in between, said member surrounding said shaft and being located below said ball support end and having an outer diameter less than that of a golf ball but large enough and located so as to protect said support end from impact from a golf club strike after a golf ball has been struck from said tee, wherein said force absorbing member is __bonded or affixed to said shaft__ and __said member is positioned to absorb and dissipate impact energy from a golf club strike__.

2. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a material that enables the shaft to withstand damage from a strike on the resilient member, and __wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a material having a durometer hardness of from about 30 to about 90 durometer__.

3. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said tee is formed from a member selected from the group consisting of wood, plastic and metal, and __wherein said force absorbing member comprises a material selected from the group consisting of neoprene, silicone rubber, and polyurethane__.

4. (Original) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a hardwood.

5. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from an engineering plastic, and __wherein said force absorbing member has a durometer hardness of from about 50 to about 60 durometer__.

6. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 5, wherein said tee is formed from a polycarbonate, and __wherein said force absorbing member comprises neoprene__.

7. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from nylon, and __wherein said force absorbing member comprises neoprene having a durometer hardness of from about 50 to about 60 durometer__.

8. (Original) The golf tee of claim 3, wherein said tee is formed from a malleable metal.

9. (Original) The golf tee of claim 8, wherein said tee is formed from aluminum.

10. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 9, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising a natural or man-made material, and __wherein said force absorbing member is bonded or affixed to said shaft__.

11. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 1, wherein said force absorbing member is formed from a force absorbing material comprising a natural or man-made material, and __wherein said force absorbing member is bonded or affixed to said shaft and positioned to absorb and dissipate impact energy__.

12. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 11, wherein said force absorbing material has a hardness of from about 30 to about 90 durometer, and __wherein said force absorbing material is selected from the group consisting of neoprene, silicone rubber, and polyurethane__.

13. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 12, wherein said force absorbing material comprises a neoprene having a hardness of from about 50 to about 60 durometer, and __wherein said neoprene is bonded or affixed to said shaft__.

14. (Currently amended) The golf tee of claim 11, wherein said force absorbing material comprises a neoprene, and __wherein said neoprene is bonded or affixed to said shaft and has a durometer hardness of from about 50 to about 60 durometer__.
